appearance_facts.fact: Chart title is 'Monthly Reservoir Inflow Volume'.
Y-axis scale ranges from 0 to 350 in increments of 50.
Bar for January reaches approximately 150 Mm3.
Bar for February reaches approximately 300 Mm3.
Bar for March reaches approximately 250 Mm3.

printed_facts.fact: Y-axis has labeled tick marks at 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350.
A dashed line labeled 'Average' is drawn at the 150 Mm3 level.
The bar for January aligns exactly with the 150 Mm3 level on the y-axis.
The bar for February is at 300 Mm3, above the average line.
The bar for March is at 250 Mm3, above the average line.
